business_delta: From accepted C03 two-crew formation, add station-specific P-CREW resource failure data: RMTBF=0.5 hour, RFTT=OPERATION and RMDT=0.25 hour, with no shift. The paired input adds exactly one idle spare crew by changing ResourceAllocation.RQTY from two to three. Descriptions identify provenance; seed 1, both aircraft, half-hour crew-dependent preparation, 8-9 mission, and 36-hour horizon remain unchanged.
pre_run_hypothesis: Under operational exposure, failure generation should occur while the crew is working, not during the long idle period. A fixed seed with RMTBF=0.5 may yield one or more failures during the two concurrent 7.5-8.0 preparations, but that is not guaranteed. The spare variant is intended to distinguish replacement by an idle crew from interruption/wait in the two-crew variant. Native events must establish the actual failure times, any active-task stop or replacement, repair completion, mission outcome, and resource/terminal ledgers. If neither run has an informative failure, retain them as diagnostics and do not publish the positive mechanism.
acceptance_requires: accepted C03 parent and dictionary/model-schema fingerprints
guarded serial session-0 SSH native runs preserving GUI PID 13340
all row-containing input tables roundtrip exactly
zero conversion errors and valid nonempty native output/report
direct resource failure and repair events with operational exposure and comparison of spare versus no spare
task ownership, crew availability, mission, system, stock and terminal-state ledgers
sealed local raw artifacts and independent read-only replay
limitations: One fixed seed, one mean time between failure, one mean downtime and one two-aircraft preparation interval on the installed executable.
Calendar failure time, off-shift spares, other seeds, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
